# telnyx_wireguard_interface (Resource)

A WireGuard interface on a network that WireGuard peers connect to.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A WireGuard interface on the office network.
resource "telnyx_wireguard_interface" "office" {
  network_id  = telnyx_network.office.id
  region_code = "ashburn-va"
  name        = "office-wg"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `network_id` (String) The id of the network associated with the interface.
- `region_code` (String) The region interface is deployed to.

### Optional

- `enable_sip_trunking` (Boolean) Enable SIP traffic forwarding over VPN interface.
- `name` (String) A user specified name for the interface.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date-time indicating when the resource was created.
- `endpoint` (String) The Telnyx WireGuard peers `Peer.endpoint` value.
- `id` (String) Identifies the resource.
- `public_key` (String) The Telnyx WireGuard peers `Peer.PublicKey`.
- `record_type` (String) Identifies the type of the resource.
- `region` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--region))
- `status` (String) The current status of the interface deployment.
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date-time indicating when the resource was updated.

<a id="nestedatt--region"></a>
### Nested Schema for `region`

Read-Only:

- `code` (String) Region code of the interface.
- `name` (String) Region name of the interface.
- `record_type` (String) Identifies the type of the resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import telnyx_wireguard_interface.example <id>
```
